title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Wedding Planning Basics
summary: Start wedding planning basics this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Set budget + 10% buffer
2. Draft guest list
3. Book venue
4. Book photographer, caterer, music
5. Buy attire (6-9 months out)

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: The Core Method for Wedding Planning Basics, Step by Step
summary: The complete wedding planning basics method from start to finish.
body:
The full method:

Step 1: Set budget + 10% buffer
Step 2: Draft guest list
Step 3: Book venue
Step 4: Book photographer, caterer, music
Step 5: Buy attire (6-9 months out)
Step 6: Send invitations (6-8 weeks out)
Step 7: Finalize details 1 month out
Step 8: Confirm vendors 1 week out
Step 9: Enjoy the day - delegate everything

Work the steps in order. Skip none — each one exists because skipping it causes a specific failure later.

title: Wedding Planning Basics: Safety, Legal, and Fine Print
summary: What to watch out for with wedding planning basics: safety, contracts, and fine print.
body:
Read before you act: Guest list before budget And: DIY-ing everything

General rules: get agreements in writing, understand what you're signing, keep records of money in and out, and know when a professional (lawyer, accountant, vet, doctor — depending on the domain) is worth the fee. An hour of professional advice beats a month of fixing.
